bio: Just off the tourist trail, these premises, once a crêperie, are now the new headquarters of Jarvis Scott. The bad boy chef, previously at the helm of Liquide, flaunted his talents on French TV's Top Chef. There is a rock 'n' roll vibe to this stripped-back, minimalist space: an intimate first room centred on an open kitchen and, upstairs, a communal table seating 10 guests in a more refined atmosphere. Far from the culinary mores of a seaside resort, the chef shakes up diners' expectations with uninhibited pairings that make a statement: frog's legs teamed with merguez, whelks mingling with sauce algérienne.
